people.name: Jericho
people.line: An ancient city in Canaan, famously conquered by Israel

translations.web: About forty thousand men, ready and armed for war, passed over before Yahweh to battle, to the plains of Jericho.
translations.bsb: About 40,000 troops armed for battle crossed over before the LORD into the plains of Jericho.
translations.kjv: About forty thousand prepared for war passed over before the LORD unto battle, to the plains of Jericho.
translations.asv: about forty thousand ready armed for war passed over before Jehovah unto battle, to the plains of Jericho.
